originalScenarioCompleteUnchanged.originalTextUnchanged: DI6-04-A: A willing explorer receives directions toward a known fixed hall. The established map has an80-foot route using an actual climb the explorer can attempt and a120-foot level corridor. The spell names the80-foot route despite its risk, with the real climb checkpoint. It does not promise the climb roll or certify that a loaded wagon fits. No magical short cut through the intervening wall is created.
